trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Express intent to pay fee in instalments and state time pressure.
steps.text: Hello, fee payment గురించి call చేస్తున్నాను. నాకు time లేదు, తొందరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Greet and ask how to help.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. Fee payment లో మీకు ఎలాంటి help కావాలి?

steps.purpose: Ask for instalments.
steps.text: నేను full semester fee ఒకేసారి pay చేయలేను. Instalments లో pay చేయొచ్చా?

steps.purpose: Confirm instalments are possible and ask for application ID.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా, instalments set చేయొచ్చు. ముందుగా మీ application ID చెబుతారా?

steps.purpose: Provide application ID.
steps.text: నా ID APP-2001. తొందరగా process చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factor.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. Security కోసం, మీ registered name లేదా పుట్టిన తేదీ చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Provide registered name with STT error.
steps.text: నా registered name వెంకట్.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided name.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state intent to check account.
steps.text: Details verify అయ్యాయి. ఒక్క నిమిషం, మీ account check చేస్తున్నాను.

steps.purpose: Express impatience.
steps.text: Make it fast, నేను ఇంకో meeting కి వెళ్ళాలి.

steps.purpose: Retrieve fee account details.
Return fee account details.
Explain fee details including scholarship rule.
steps.text: మీ total fee 185000, అందులో 50000 pay చేశారు. మీ account కి scholarship percent 0 ఉంది, కాబట్టి ఇంకా 135000 due ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask to convert balance to instalments.
steps.text: అవును, నాకు తెలుసు. ఆ balance amount ని instalments గా మార్చండి.

steps.purpose: Ask for the number of instalments.
steps.text: మీరు 2, 3, లేదా 4 instalments గా pay చేయొచ్చు. మీకు ఎన్ని instalments కావాలి?

steps.purpose: Specify 3 instalments and ask about extra charges.
steps.text: 3 instalments అయితే నాకు better. ఏమైనా extra charges ఉంటాయా?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the choice of 3 instalments and state intent to generate the plan to check the final amounts.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent avoids making an unsupported guarantee about extra charges before the tool is called.
steps.text: సరే, నేను 3 instalments plan ని సెట్ చేసి చూస్తాను. అప్పుడు మీకు exact per-instalment amount తెలుస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan.
Return instalment plan details.
State the active plan and per-instalment amount.
steps.text: మీ instalment plan active అయింది. మీరు per instalment 45000 pay చేయాలి.

steps.purpose: Ask for a discount/waiver.
steps.text: ఏమైనా scholarship or discount add చేయగలరా? నాకు ఎవరో 10 percent discount ఉంటుంది అన్నారు.

steps.purpose: Refuse the discount.
steps.text: మీ account లో scholarship percent 0 ఉంది. మేము ఎలాంటి fee waivers ఇవ్వలేము.

steps.purpose: Ask for the first EMI date.
steps.text: Okay, first EMI ఎప్పుడు pay చేయాలి?

steps.purpose: Refuse to provide a date.
steps.text: నా దగ్గర plan active అని మాత్రమే information ఉంది. Exact dates కోసం మీరు student portal check చేయాలి.

steps.purpose: Accept and hang up.
steps.text: సరే, నేను చూసుకుంటాను. నేను కాల్ కట్ చేస్తున్నాను.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active and per-instalment amount stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: When the user requests to pay in instalments (e15), the agent does not immediately call the tool with a guessed number. Instead, it prompts the user for the required number of instalments (e16), waits for the user's choice (e17), and only then invokes setup_instalment_plan (e19).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Invocation > Partial Invocation Prevention

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds the fee amounts and scholarship status (e14) and the per-instalment amount (e21) in the tool results. It also correctly refuses to provide the first EMI date because the tool did not return it (e25). However, in e18, it violates the negative constraint by guaranteeing there are no extra charges before even calling the tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e18, the agent explicitly guarantees 'అదనపు charges ఏమీ ఉండవు' (There will be no extra charges) in response to the user's question. Because the agent has not yet called the setup_instalment_plan tool, and the lookup tool does not provide this information, this is an unsupported claim that violates the Tool Output Grounding variant.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e18 so the agent does not guarantee the absence of extra charges. The agent should simply acknowledge the choice of 3 instalments and state that they are generating the plan to check the final amounts.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly follows the business rules, handles the Telugu/English mixing naturally, and successfully demonstrates partial invocation prevention. However, it fails on strict Tool Output Grounding because the agent makes an unsupported forward guarantee about extra charges before executing the instalment setup tool. A surface repair on e18 is required.

variant_findings.reason: When the user asks to convert the balance to instalments (e15), the agent lacks the mandatory 'instalments' argument for the setup_instalment_plan tool. It correctly asks the user for this value (e16), waits for the user to provide it (e17), and only then invokes the tool (e19).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Invocation > Partial Invocation Prevention

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool output. When asked about extra charges (e17), it avoids making an unsupported guarantee and defers to the tool's upcoming result (e18). When asked for the first EMI date (e24), it explicitly states that the tool only provided the 'active' status and does not invent a date, directing the user to the portal instead (e25).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is logically sound, adheres to all business rules and tool schemas, and successfully realizes both target variants. The agent appropriately handles missing mandatory arguments by asking the user before invoking tools, and strictly grounds its responses in the provided tool outputs without hallucinating extra details like dates or guarantees. The persona is consistently maintained, and the language accurately reflects the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode.
